titolo: Kimusky
paesi_vittima: France, Slovakia, United Kingdom, United States
descrizione: This threat actor targeted foreign ministries and think tanks in Europe and the United States using malware hidden in Microsoft Word documents and antiquated file formats.

titolo: Targeting of American defense industry
descrizione: The North Korean threat actor Lazarus Group leveraged a Windows update to conduct spear-phishing attacks, sending fake job offers from Lockheed Martin. Lazarus has used fake job offers in the past to plant malware on defense industry systems.

titolo: Targeting of South Korean individuals and organizations with fake Itaewon disaster documents
descrizione: APT 37 was detected using a zero day in the Internet Explorer application as part of a phishing campaign against South Korean users. APT 37 also used a lure document purporting to analyze the stampede that occurred at Itaewon, a neighborhood in Seoul, on October 29, 2022, to entice users to open the phishing document. […]

titolo: Targeting of CyberLink customers in supply-chain attack
descrizione: Lazarus Group compromised Taiwanese software provider CyberLink’s network and embedded malicious code in an update of CyberLink’s Promeo software. The attack appeared aimed at compromising the networks of CyberLink customers, including critical government, financial, and defense systems in countries including the United States, Canada, Japan, and Taiwan.

titolo: Targeting of Google Chrome users in the United States, South Korea, and Europe, particularly those involved in research into North Korean affairs
descrizione: Zscaler observed Kimsuky leveraging a malicious version of a Google Chrome extension, which Zscaler named “Translatext,” to steal information. The extension allows Kimsuky to bypass popular email servers’ security measures and access users’ inboxes.

titolo: Targeting of aerospace and defense organizations worldwide
descrizione: Moonstone Sleet, a North Korean actor identified in May 2024, developed a custom ransomware variant called FakePenny, which it deployed at organizations in aerospace and defense after exfiltrating data from the compromised networks.

titolo: Moonstone Sleet
descrizione: Moonstone Sleet is a North Korean threat actor that has previously been observed deploying ransomware on aerospace and defense systems.

titolo: Targeting of South Korean defense industry
descrizione: The Seoul Metropolitan Police said that Lazarus Group had broken into the networks of several companies connected to the South Korean defense industry and managed to steal sensitive information about anti-aircraft systems the companies manufacture or design.

titolo: Targeting of South Korean research institutes
descrizione: North Korean threat actor Kimsuky targeted South Korean research institutes with a malicious import declaration. Opening the document would give Kimsuky access to the victim’s network.

titolo: Targeting of customers of a South Korean asset management program
descrizione: Lazarus Group inserted malware into a program run by a South Korean asset management company. The attack appears to have been targeted at the company’s customers.

titolo: Targeting of Danish critical infrastructure companies
descrizione: Starting in May 2023, Russian threat actor Sandworm used a vulnerability in Zyxel firewalls to break into the networks of twenty-two Danish companies operating in different critical infrastructure sectors.

titolo: Targeting of blockchain engineers at a cryptocurrency exchange
descrizione: Lazarus Group distributed a compromised cryptocurrency arbitrage bot on public services on the chat service Discord. The attack was highly targeted, with the goal of gaining access to the network of a cryptocurrency company.

titolo: Targeting of Mixin cryptocurrency network
descrizione: Hong Kong–based cryptocurrency exchange Mixin said North Korea hackers stole over $200 million in cryptocurrency after breaching Mixin’s cloud service provider.

titolo: Targeting of CoinEx cryptocurrency exchange
descrizione: Lazarus Group stole almost $54 million in various cryptocurrencies from the CoinEx exchange. Some of the funds were moved into a wallet that contained stolen funds from an earlier theft of cryptocurrency from the Stake.com gambling platform.

titolo: Targeting of Stake virtual currency service
descrizione: Lazarus Group stole $41 million in cryptocurrency from the online gambling platform Stake.com.

titolo: Targeting of South Korean defense industry and an electronics manufacturer
descrizione: Andariel, a subgroup of Lazarus Group, attacked South Korean defense companies and an electronics device manufacturer in March 2023. The group used several malware strains that have been used in previous attacks on South Korean universities.

titolo: Targeting of internet infrastructure provider in Europe
descrizione: Lazarus Group deployed a new variety of remote-access Trojan, dubbed QuiteRAT, on the networks of a European internet backbone infrastructure provider.

titolo: Targeting of Russian missile design firm
descrizione: APT 37, a North Korean threat actor, compromised sensitive networks, including an email server, at the Russian missile design firm NPO Mashinostroyeniya. The company has previously been involved in designing hypersonic missiles and newer generation ballistic missiles.

titolo: Targeting of CoinsPaid cryptocurrency service
descrizione: CoinsPaid, a cryptocurrency management firm, was hacked by the North Korean threat actor Lazarus Group. Lazarus managed to steal almost $38 million in various kinds of cryptocurrency.

titolo: Targeting of GitHub users with an interest in cryptocurrency
descrizione: North Korean threat actor Lazarus Group used spear-phishing lures to distribute GitHub repositories, usually pretending to be media players or cryptocurrency trading tools, which contain malicious code. The attacks share commonalities with another North Korean cyberattack detected in June 2022, TraderTraitor.

titolo: Targeting of IT company as part of a supply-chain attack
descrizione: North Korean threat actors targeted the systems of an information technology firm, JumpCloud. After gaining access to JumpCloud’s systems, the operators targeted several JumpCloud customers involved in the cryptocurrency trade.

titolo: Targeting of users of Naver
descrizione: North Korean hackers set up a fake website designed to look like the South Korean web portal and search engine Naver, according to a report by the South Korean National Intelligence Service.

titolo: Targeting of Atomic Wallet cryptocurrency users
descrizione: North Korean hackers stole over $100 million in cryptocurrency from over five thousand cryptocurrency wallets run by a company called Atomic Wallet.

titolo: Targeting of South Korean professors, dissidents, and human rights advocates
descrizione: APT 37, a North Korean hacking group, distributed information-stealing malware through Ably, a South Korean data-transfer and messaging application. The malware could be used to steal information from the victim’s computer and to record video and audio and exfiltrate it.

titolo: Targeting of analysts of North Korean affairs
descrizione: Kimsuky used social engineering techniques to deploy ReconShark malware against former South Korean government officials and researchers focused on North Korean affairs. The group focused on expanding access to affected systems and stealing subscriptions to the North Korea-focused news website NKNews.

titolo: Targeting of cryptocurrency exchanges in DangerousPassword campaign
descrizione: BlueNoroff, a subcluster of the threat actor Lazarus Group, sent malicious shortcut files to cryptocurrency exchanges as part of an expansion of its DangerousPassword campaign. The malware was distributed both over email and through LinkedIn messages.

titolo: Targeting of South Korean hospital network
descrizione: Kimsuky attacked the networks of Seoul National University Hospital in 2021 and stole personal data from over eight hundred thousand current and former patients and employees. Two years later, South Korean police attributed the attack to North Korea.

titolo: Targeting of manufacturing and real-estate sectors in India and telecommunications companies in Bulgaria and Pakistan
descrizione: A Lazarus Group campaign, active from early 2020 until January 2023, leveraged a backdoored UltraVNC client against manufacturing and real-estate sectors in India and telecommunications companies in Pakistan and Bulgaria. The goal of the operation, whose scope extends beyond Bulgaria, India, and Pakistan, appears to be intelligence collection.

titolo: Targeting of South Korean institutions
descrizione: Chinese actor Tonto Team targeted South Korean education, construction, diplomatic, and political institutions with a malicious file related to anti-malware products.

titolo: Targeting of Mac users at financial institutions
descrizione: BlueNoroff, a subgroup of North Korea’s Lazarus Group, was observed using a new Mac operating-system malware family, dubbed RustBucket, in recent attacks on Mac machines. Based on the lures used, BlueNoroff likely targeted the financial technology sector with the malware. RustBucket can be used to gather system information and allows the attacker to perform various […]

titolo: Targeting of human rights groups and activists related to human rights advocacy in North Korea
descrizione: An APT group with similarities to Kimusky compromised legitimate business websites to target human rights groups and activists in North Korea.

titolo: Targeting of experts in North Korea policy issues
descrizione: In a recent phishing campaign, North Korean threat actor Kimsuky posed as media outlets and think tanks and requested interviews or information about North Korea. The emails contained malicious links redirecting to fake login pages that harvested user credentials.

titolo: Targeting of 3CXDesktopApp customers and crypto firms
descrizione: Suspected members of the North Korean Lazarus Group targeted customers of the voice and video conferencing software 3CXDesktopApp in a financially motivated supply-chain attack during March 2023. The infected infrastructure was spread primarily across European countries, with additional victims in South Africa, the United Kingdom, and North America. In addition to being targeted with an […]

titolo: Targeting of an Indian medical research organization and technology and energy sectors
descrizione: Lazarus Group targeted an Indian health-care organization, a technology manufacturer, and the chemical engineering department of a leading research university. The campaign’s goal appeared to be collecting intelligence on major Indian industries.

titolo: Targeting of Harmony cryptocurrency bridge
descrizione: Lazarus Group stole nearly $100 million in cryptocurrency from the platform Harmony Bridge in June 2022. The FBI formally attributed the hack to Lazarus in January 2023 after the hackers attempted to launder nearly $60 million through cryptocurrency mixers and a series of wallets.`

titolo: Targeting of users of Kakao
descrizione: Kimsuky, a North Korean threat actor, ran a phishing campaign that distributed fake login pages for the popular South Korean messaging app Kakao. Kimsuky likely aimed to steal victims’ passwords; whether the campaign specifically targeted any users is unclear.

titolo: Targeting of non-fungible token (NFT) owners
descrizione: Lazarus Group targeted the owners of non-fungible tokens in a phishing campaign. The phishing sites allowed Lazarus to drain victims’ accounts of both NFTs and cryptocurrencies.

titolo: Targeting of users of cryptocurrency applications
descrizione: North Korean hacking group Lazarus created a fake brand called BloxHolder to spread fake cryptocurrency apps that would infect users with AppleJeus malware to steal money and cryptocurrency. The campaign was active from June to at least October 2022.

titolo: Targeting of Japanese crypto-asset businesses
descrizione: Lazarus, a North Korean state-sponsored hacking group, conducted several years of phishing attacks aimed at Japanese crypto-asset businesses to steal cryptocurrency.

titolo: Targeting of South Korean diplomats, professors, and researchers
descrizione: Kimsuky was found launching spear-phishing attacks against numerous current and former South Korean diplomats and prominent foreign policy academics in South Korea.

titolo: Targeting of South Korea with multiple spear-phishing campaigns
descrizione: A North Korean threat actor targeted South Korean government agencies, think tanks, and companies in the defense, education, energy, and medical-care sectors using spear- phishing campaigns to extract confidential information.

titolo: Targeting of European Union (EU) member states
descrizione: A North Korean advanced persistent threat group used malware known as Konni, a remote-access Trojan, to hack into high-level organizations across the EU.

titolo: Targeting of various industries with Maui ransomware
descrizione: The Lazarus Group used Maui ransomware to target government and civil institutions in order to raise money for the North Korean government.

titolo: Targeting of specialized engineering companies
descrizione: North Korean threat actor Lazarus Group targeted a specialized engineering company to steal sensitive intellectual property. The hackers breached the organization’s network by exploiting the Log4j vulnerability, moving laterally to compromise eighteen other computers. The hackers installed a backdoor to steal credentials and exfiltrate sensitive data.

titolo: Targeting of journalists reporting on North Korea
descrizione: North Korea–linked threat actor APT 37 targeted journalists with novel Goldbackdoor malware. APT 37 initially used RokRat malware to hack the email account of a former director at South Korea’s National Intelligence Service. The hackers then impersonated the official and targeted South Korean journalists, sending emails laced with Goldbackdoor malware. The malware can be used […]

titolo: Targeting of cryptocurrency company employees
descrizione: North Korean hackers targeted cryptocurrency company employees in a phishing campaign to access systems and make fraudulent trades. Lazarus sent mass emails with job offers embedded with malicious links. When victims clicked, their devices downloaded TraderTraitor malware, which enabled the hackers to execute commands and infiltrate company networks to make fraudulent blockchain transactions.

titolo: Targeting of Axie Infinity’s Ronin Network
descrizione: The North Korea–linked Lazarus Group stole more than $600 million worth of cryptocurrency from the Axie Infinity video game. The hackers infiltrated Ronin Network, a decentralized finance platform used to earn and pay for in-game items with cryptocurrency. Lazarus then used a cryptocurrency mixer, Tornado Cash, to launder a portion of the stolen funds to […]

titolo: Targeting of South Korean chemical sector organizations
descrizione: In an extension of its Operation Dream Job campaign, North Korea’s Lazarus Group targeted individuals working at chemical sector organizations in South Korea. Lazarus used fake job-themed lures to bait victims into opening a malicious link and downloading malware used for cyber espionage.

titolo: Targeting of American news media and IT companies
descrizione: The Lazarus Group used a Google Chrome zero-day to target employees at American news media and IT companies. The Lazarus Group used phishing emails impersonating recruiters at Disney, Google, and Oracle with fake job opportunities, which included malicious links to spoofed Indeed and ZipRecruiter websites. An exploit kit hidden within the websites fingerprinted the target […]

titolo: Targeting of the International Atomic Energy Agency and South Korean defense contractor
descrizione: The North Korean threat actor Kimsuky used spear-phishing techniques to masquerade as websites and applications to get victims to input their credentials. The victims included a security officer at the International Atomic Energy Agency.

titolo: Targeting of cryptocurrency start-ups
descrizione: BlueNoroff, an offshoot of the North Korean threat actor Lazarus Group, mounted a long-running campaign against cryptocurrency firms and exchanges in a bid to steal cryptocurrency.

titolo: Targeting of Russian diplomats in Asia
descrizione: The North Korean threat actor Konni launched a spear-phishing campaign against Russian diplomats in Indonesia. Konni spoofed the email address of the Russian embassy in Serbia to send a fake celebratory email that downloaded a remote access trojan once opened.

titolo: Targeting of South Korean company recruiters
descrizione: Hackers from the North Korean Lazarus Group sent malware disguised as job openings at Samsung to engineers. These attacks followed a methodology similar to that of a July 2021 Lazarus Group campaign against engineering firms in South Korea.

titolo: Targeting of Chinese cybersecurity researchers.
descrizione: The North Korean cyber gang Lazarus Group was accused of attempting to breach Chinese cyber espionage groups’ systems in 2020 in an effort to exploit zero-days and other vulnerabilities. The effort is likely related to an earlier North Korean attempt to attack cybersecurity researchers in the United States and Eastern Europe.

titolo: Targeting of South Korean think tank
descrizione: Using an unusual route to gain access to civil society and government groups, North Korean hackers accessed the servers of a South Korean think tank by compromising a Latvian company providing third-party services.

titolo: Watering-hole attack on popular North Korean news site
descrizione: North Korea launched watering-hole attacks from popular anti-North Korea website the Daily NK.

titolo: Targeting of prospective engineers and programmers
descrizione: Lazarus Group was accused of sending phishing emails pretending to be from major engineering firms to engineers looking for work. The engineers were prompted to download malicious Microsoft Word documents.

titolo: Targeting of South Korean nuclear research center
descrizione: South Korea’s nuclear research center detected an intrusion into its systems in the middle of May 2021, but was able to remove the malicious code from its VPN before it could be executed.

titolo: Targeting of South Korean companies with ransomware
descrizione: North Korean hackers launched ransomware attacks on South Korean businesses. The malware used is an old incarnation of Lazarus Group’s espionage tools with added ransomware functionality.

titolo: Targeting of South Korean government
descrizione: The South Korean government was targeted in a wide-ranging attack by North Korean threat actors. The attacks installed the AppleSeed backdoor, which was used to exfiltrate information.

titolo: Targeting of South African freight companies
descrizione: Vyveva, a known Lazarus Group malware tool, was spotted in the systems of South African shipping companies. The malware appears designed to facilitate file transfers.

titolo: Targeting of the defense industry
descrizione: North Korean APT Lazarus Group used a custom backdoor dubbed ThreatNeedle to laterally move through infected defense firm networks and gather sensitive information in over a dozen countries. The actor achieved initial entry to victim networks through spear-phishing emails with malicious attachments or links.

titolo: Targeting of cryptocurrency exchanges and financial service companies
descrizione: North Korean APT Lazarus Group disseminated cryptocurrency trading applications outfitted with the AppleJeus malware. AppleJeus was used to steal cryptocurrency from unsuspecting victims in over thirty countries in 2020.

titolo: Targeting of Pfizer vaccine data
descrizione: South Korean lawmaker Ha Tae-keung told reporters that North Korean hackers attempted to steal COVID-19 vaccine data from U.S. pharmaceutical company Pfizer. It is unclear whether the alleged operation was successful.

titolo: Targeting of security researchers with malware
descrizione: North Korean hackers used spear-phishing social media techniques to target security researchers to install malware onto targets’ Windows systems.

titolo: Targeting of companies involved in vaccine development
descrizione: North Korean hackers targeted at least six companies involved in the development of a COVID-19 vaccine. Masquerading as recruiters on WhatsApp and LinkedIn, the hackers used documents containing fake job descriptions to install malware on computers belonging to company staff.

titolo: Targeting of South Korean supply chains using stolen security certificates
descrizione: The North Korean threat actor Lazarus Group targeted South Korean users of WIZVERA VeraPort software, commonly used by South Korean banking and government websites, by compromising websites with VeraPort support. Using stolen security certificates, hackers installed malware onto victims’ devices when they visited the compromised websites.

titolo: Zinc
paesi_vittima: Canada, France, India, Korea (Republic of), United States
descrizione: Hackers posing as recruiters in spear-phishing emails to steal credentials belonging to individuals involved in vaccine development.

titolo: Cerium
paesi_vittima: Canada, France, India, Korea (Republic of), United States
descrizione: Hackers posing as World Health Organization officials in spear-phishing emails to steal credentials belonging to individuals involved in vaccine development.

titolo: Targeting of vaccine researchers with fake job opportunities
descrizione: The North Korean threat group Zinc used spear-phishing emails to pose as job recruiters.

titolo: Targeting of vaccine researchers with spear-phishing emails
descrizione: The North Korean threat group Cerium masqueraded as World Health Organization representatives in spear-phishing emails to victims.

titolo: Targeting of experts and think tanks in the United States, Japan, and South Korea
descrizione: The North Korean threat actor APT Kimsuky targeted think tanks in the United States, Japan, and South Korea working on nuclear policy and sanctions. The hackers used spear-phishing emails and watering-hole attacks to gain access to victims’ networks.

titolo: Targeting of Russian aerospace and defense companies
descrizione: North Korean hackers used spear-phishing emails and social media messages in hopes of stealing credentials related to Russian aerospace and defense companies.

titolo: Targeting of UN officials
descrizione: North Korean hackers launched a spear-phishing campaign that disguised malware as UN security alerts and interview requests. At least twenty-eight UN officials, eleven of whom represented six members of the UN Security Council, were targeted.

titolo: Targeting of automated teller machines worldwide
paesi_vittima: Argentina, Bangladesh, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Brazil, Bulgaria, Chile, Costa Rica, Ecuador, Ghana, India, Indonesia, Japan, Jordan, Kenya, Korea (Republic of), Kuwait, Malaysia, Malta, Mexico, Mozambique, Nepal, Nicaragua, Nigeria, Pakistan, Panama, Peru, Singapore, South Africa, Spain, Taiwan, Tanzania, United Republic of, The Philippines, Togo, Turkey, Uganda, Uruguay, Vietnam, Zambia
descrizione: Hackers affiliated with the Lazarus Group targeted automated teller machines (ATMs) by manipulating transaction-processing software to initiate fraudulent cash-outs.

titolo: Targeting of U.S. defense contractors
descrizione: North Korean hackers used fake job postings from leading U.S. defense contractors on LinkedIn to install malicious data-gathering software when clicked.

titolo: Targeting of defense companies in Israel and the Middle East
descrizione: Responsible for using social engineering and lofty job postings to coax employees into downloading malware that ultimately stole classified data.

titolo: Targeting of Central European aerospace and defense companies
descrizione: Hackers impersonated recruiters from Collins Aerospace and General Dynamics to lure in employees with enticing job offers, subsequently tricking them into opening malicious files sent via LinkedIn’s private messaging app.

titolo: Targeting of global financial institutions
descrizione: Hidden Cobra used a variety of malware tools to hack into and steal money from banks, cryptocurrency exchanges, and ATMs.

titolo: Targeting of North Koreans and North Korea–focused professionals
descrizione: DarkHotel, a South Korea–linked threat actor, used five zero-days in a single campaign targeting North Koreans, demonstrating an unusual level of sophistication.

titolo: Konni Group
descrizione: Attempted to trick employees of unnamed U.S. government agency to install malware on their computers via a spearphishing campaign.

titolo: Spear-phishing campaign against unnamed U.S. government agency
descrizione: The suspected North Korean threat actor Konni Group attempted to trick employees of an unnamed U.S. government agency to install malware on their computers via a spear-phishing campaign.

titolo: Continued targeting of cryptocurrency businesses
descrizione: The North Korean hackers renewed attacks against unnamed cryptocurrency businesses to steal cryptocurrency for financial gain.

titolo: Targeting of South Korean macOS users
descrizione: The North Korean threat actor Lazarus Group targeted South Korean macOS users with a new malware variant.

titolo: Compromise of Indian nuclear power plant
descrizione: Devices on a noncritical administrative network in a nuclear power plant in Tamil Nadu, India, were compromised by DTrack, a remote access Trojan (RAT) associated with the Lazarus Group.

titolo: Targeting of Indian space agency
descrizione: North Korean hackers attacked the Indian Space Research Organization as part of a broader assault on India’s government agencies.

titolo: Autumn Aperture—malware embedded in antiquated file types
descrizione: A threat actor targeted U.S.-based entities by emailing them malware-laced Microsoft Word documents written by industry experts. The trojanized documents discussed nuclear deterrence, North Korea’s nuclear submarine program, and economic sanctions on the North Korean regime. This incident is believed to be an extension of the August Autumn Aperture campaign.

titolo: Autumn Aperture—use of malicious websites to target foreign ministries and other entities
paesi_vittima: China, France, Slovakia, South Africa, United States
descrizione: A threat actor targeted a number of foreign ministries, a Chinese technology company, Stanford University, think tanks in the United States and the United Kingdom, and other entities that have focused on North Korea’s nuclear efforts or the related international sanctions. The threat actor created a network of malicious websites imitating the login portals of […]

titolo: Targeting of U.S. university and think tank with BabyShark malware
descrizione: A threat actor used the malware BabyShark, which uses infrastructure associated with North Korean campaigns. The malware was delivered in November 2018 via spear-phishing emails written to appear as though they were sent from a nuclear security expert who works as a consultant for the U.S. government. The subject of the emails referenced North Korea’s […]

titolo: Compromise of South Korean resettlement agency
descrizione: The personal information of nearly one thousand North Koreans who defected to South Korea was leaked after unknown hackers gained access to the database of South Korea’s resettlement agency.

titolo: Global bank attacks
paesi_vittima: Bangladesh, Brazil, Chile, Malaysia, Mexico, Poland, Russian Federation, Taiwan, The Philippines, Turkey, United States, Uruguay, Vietnam
descrizione: A North Korean group is believed to have stolen hundreds of millions of dollars by infiltrating the computer systems of banks around the world since 2014.

titolo: Targeting of AMC Theatres
descrizione: A threat actor targeted U.S. movie theater chain AMC Theatres in 2014 using spear-phishing techniques. The U.S. Department of Justice alleges that the incident was related to the chain’s screenings of The Interview, a movie depicting the assassination of North Korean leader Kim Jong-un.

titolo: Targeting of Mammoth Screen
descrizione: A threat actor targeted Mammoth Screen, a UK production company that produced Opposite Number, a television drama set in North Korea.

titolo: Targeting of U.S. defense contractors
descrizione: A threat actor targeted the networks of Lockheed Martin, a U.S. defense contractor. It is one of the developers of the Terminal High Altitude Area Defense (THAAD) system installed in South Korea.

titolo: Targeting of North Korean defectors and journalists
descrizione: A threat actor targets North Korean defectors and journalists with an interest in North Korea by compromising their Android devices, for espionage.

titolo: Operation GhostSecret
paesi_vittima: Australia, Bangladesh, Brazil, Canada, China, France, Germany, Guatemala, Hong Kong, India, Japan, Thailand, United Kingdom, United States
descrizione: A threat actor targets critical infrastructure and organizations in the entertainment, finance, health-care, education, and telecommunications sectors.

titolo: APT 37
descrizione: This threat actor uses social engineering techniques to target companies in the chemicals, electronics, manufacturing, aerospace, automotive, and health-care sectors, as well as the South Korean government.

titolo: Targeting of global financial organizations and bitcoin users
descrizione: A threat actor targeted financial organizations and bitcoin users, for the purpose of identifying individuals with bitcoin wallets.

titolo: Targeting of U.S. electric companies
descrizione: A threat actor targeted U.S. electric companies with spear-phishing emails in an attempt to gain access to internal networks.

titolo: Compromise of Far Eastern International Bank
descrizione: A threat actor compromised the networks of Far Eastern International Bank in Taiwan, allowing them to transfer US$60 million to accounts based in the United States, Cambodia, and Sri Lanka using the SWIFT network.

titolo: Targeting North Korea’s Reconnaissance General Bureau
descrizione: U.S. government officials told the Washington Post that the United States had launched a denial of service campaign against North Korea’s Reconnaissance General Bureau, the country’s intelligence agency.

titolo: Compromise of cryptocurrency exchanges in South Korea
descrizione: A threat actor targeted cryptocurrency exchanges in South Korea for the purpose of raising money.

titolo: WannaCry
paesi_vittima: China, France, Germany, Japan, Russian Federation, Spain, United Kingdom, United States
descrizione: A threat actor used a tool called WannaCry to encrypt data in compromised networks, and intended to provide the victims with the decryption key only after a ransom had been paid. The threat actors used an exploit, called EternalBlue–first discovered by the U.S. National Security Agency–to propagate WannaCry in organizations using the Windows operating system. On December […]

titolo: Compromise the North Korean nuclear program
descrizione: A threat actor, believed to be the United States, targeted computer networks and electronic components associated with the North Korean nuclear program to sabotage and slow its development.

titolo: Compromise of South Korean government computers (2016)
descrizione: A threat actor compromised computers associated with the South Korean Ministry of National Defense. In October 2017, South Korean officials confirmed that North Korea had exfiltrated over two hundred gigabytes of data from the defense ministry networks, including military plans the United States and South Korea would implement in the event of a war with North […]

titolo: Compromise of computer networks associated with diplomats, journalists, and others in South Korea
descrizione: Threat actors targeted the email accounts of South Korean diplomats, journalists, and security officials.

titolo: SWIFT-related bank heists
descrizione: A threat actor targets the worldwide financial transfer mechanism known as SWIFT to steal funds from banks in Bangladesh, Vietnam, Ecuador, and Poland. This is the first instance in where a state-sponsored actor was discovered to have compromised networks for financial gain. In September 2018, the U.S. Department of Justice announced criminal charges alleging that […]

titolo: Lazarus Group
paesi_vittima: Bangladesh, Israel, Korea (Republic of), United States
descrizione: This threat actor targets and compromises entities primarily in South Korea and South Korean interests for espionage, disruption, and destruction. It has also been known to conduct cyber operations for financial gain, including targeting cryptocurrency exchanges. In 2018, the U.S. Department of Homeland Security issued a malware analysis report on a tool called Typeframe used […]

titolo: Compromise of South Korean government computers (2015)
descrizione: A threat actor compromised government networks affiliated with members of the South Korean parliament. The threat actor also attempted to compromise the Foreign Ministry, Defense Ministry, and the Blue House.

titolo: Compromise of the Seoul subway system
descrizione: A threat actor compromised networks associated with Seoul’s subway system.

titolo: Compromise of Sony Pictures Entertainment
descrizione: Threat actors compromised the networks of Sony Pictures Entertainment, destroyed data, and publicly released employee emails. The United States attributed the incident to North Korea, which is believed to have staged the attack to prevent Sony from releasing the film The Interview, which depicts an assassination plot against North Korean leader Kim Jong-un. The compromise […]

titolo: Unresponsive computer networks in South Korea
descrizione: Threat actors compromised the computer networks of South Korean broadcasters and two banks, making them unresponsive.

titolo: Denial of service incident against South Korean and U.S. targets
descrizione: Dubbed “Ten Days of Rain,” this attack was a ten-day denial of service campaign that targeted websites associated with the South Korean government and U.S. military forces in South Korea.
